manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball at its peak with a ball released from rest. Both experience constant downward acceleration due to gravity.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes showing vertical motion. On the left, a tossed ball climbs, stops instantaneously at the apex, and falls. On the right, a gate releases a second ball from rest at that exact apex height. Both balls then fall together with identical velocity and acceleration.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration. Press Play again to continue, or drag the timeline. At top jumps to the shared release.
